# dist

What goes on a board or into VS Code, built by `make dist` (not kept in git).
Releases attach these files on GitHub.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| pico2.uf2 | the kernel and register table for the Pico 2 and Pico 2 W: drag onto the RP2350 drive (hold BOOTSEL while plugging in) |
| rp2350.tbl | the register table alone (already in the image) |
| littleforth-*.vsix | the VS Code extension: Extensions > ... > Install from VSIX |
